plugins.name: clarity
plugins.description: Brings extra clarity to Claude's replies: status pills, labels with icons, distinct headings and a closing "What I need from you" section, drawn by its own markdown renderer

plugins.name: grill-q-prompt
plugins.description: When a reply asks a grilling round of numbered questions (❓ Q1, ❓ Q2, …), fills the empty prompt box with an answer template: one `qN. ` line per question.

plugins.name: md-glow
plugins.description: Offers markdown files written in the session for viewing in a pane, rendered by the local glow CLI

plugins.name: skill-augment
plugins.description: Augments the prompts of skills you can't edit: markdown files under ~/.claude/skills-augment and <project>/.claude/skills-augment name the skills they add to and whether their text goes at the start or end of the skill's prompt.

plugins.name: skill-prompt-view
plugins.description: Shows each skill's expanded prompt inline in the transcript, as the model received it
